english.title: Fail to erect a hoarding / fence during building work
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person proposing to

(A)_[erect]_
(B)_[take down]_
(C)_[alter the outside of]_
(D)_[repair the outside of]_

a building in a street or court at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed, before beginning the work, to erect a close boarded hoarding or fence to the satisfaction of **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, so as to separate the building from the street or court
english.legislation: Contrary to section 172(1) and (5) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
erect a hoarding / fence
during building work
in contravention of s.172 requirements

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
